title: Logic Pro Price 2026: Purchase, Subscription, Bundle
summary: Logic Pro price comes in three forms: one-time Mac purchase, iPad subscription, or Creator Studio bundle. Compare them to find the best fit for you.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is Logic Pro a one-time payment or a subscription?


It's both, depending on the device. On the Mac, Logic Pro is a one-time purchase from the Mac App Store. On the iPad, it's a subscription.


Get it wrong and you pay for either a renewal you didn't plan for or a purchase that doesn't cover the tablet. Check the product page for the device you'll actually use before you pay.


The Apple Creator Studio bundle is also billed as a subscription, so treat it as a renewal and not a purchase.


### Does Logic Pro run on Windows?


No. Apple makes Logic Pro for the Mac and the iPad only, and its product pages list no Windows version. If you work on a Windows PC, the real cost of Logic Pro includes buying a Mac.


There's no workaround listed on Apple's pages, so the only route to Logic Pro from Windows is a Mac. Price that hardware into your comparison before you compare Logic Pro with any other digital audio workstation.


### Does buying Logic Pro for Mac include the iPad version?


No. The Mac purchase and the iPad subscription are separate products, and paying for one doesn't unlock the other. Someone who buys the Mac app and expects to open projects on a tablet will find they have to pay again.


If you need both, work out the combined cost, or look at whether the bundle covers your setup for less. Apple's pages for each version describe what that version includes.


### Can I use Logic Pro on more than one Mac?


Generally yes, within Apple's licence terms. A Mac App Store purchase is tied to your Apple Account, so you can download it on other Macs signed in to that account.


This is the usual question from someone with a desktop at home and a laptop for travel.


Whether the app can be shared with family members is a separate question. Apple's licence terms and Family Sharing settings decide that, so read them before you assume a second person is covered.


### Is there a free trial of Logic Pro?


Apple has offered free trials of Logic Pro, but the length and availability can change, so the listing is the only reliable source.


Look at the App Store page for your device and check what the trial covers and what it converts into when it ends.


If you forget to cancel, a trial on the subscription version can roll into a paid renewal. Set a reminder on the day you start it.
